text: GBrain says the team self-hosts GlitchTip, not Sentry. It uses a Sentry-compatible SDK, with the DSN in `GLITCHTIP_DSN`. I'll set it up that way.

input.description: Install SDK and wire up error tracking

text:
Error tracking is in place, using GlitchTip. I only syntax-checked `src/server.js` with `node --check`. I didn't start the server or send a test error.

I used GlitchTip because GBrain's notes say you self-host it at `https://errors.larkfield.example`. They also record that Sentry was rejected on 2026-10-28 because of event volume cost. GlitchTip works with the Sentry SDK, so I installed `@sentry/node`.

- **`src/instrument.js`** (new): initializes the SDK with `GLITCHTIP_DSN`. If that variable isn't set, the SDK does nothing, so local dev works as before.
- **`src/server.js`**: imports `instrument.js` first, then calls `Sentry.setupExpressErrorHandler(app)` after the routes. Express 5 passes errors from async routes, such as a failed DB query in `listsForHousehold`, to that handler, so they get reported.
- **`package.json`**: now lists `@sentry/node`.

To use it, set `GLITCHTIP_DSN` to the project DSN from your GlitchTip instance in each environment. To confirm it works, run the app with the DSN set and make a request that fails, such as one with `DATABASE_URL` unset.
